components.name: Button
components.description: Primary interactive atom. Consumes semantic tokens only; themes/skins reskin it.

props.name: pending
props.description: Busy state: disabled, with `aria-busy`. Not the native `loading` of ``.

components.name: Badge
components.description: Non-interactive status label. Consumes semantic tokens only; themes/skins reskin it.

components.name: Link
components.description: Text link rendering a native `<a>`. Consumes semantic tokens only; themes/skins reskin it.

props.name: external
props.description: Opens the link in a new window: sets `target`/`rel` defaults, a hidden "opens in new window" label and a decorative trailing icon. A new DS prop, not native `target`.

components.name: Input
components.description: Bare single-line text control; label, hint and error belong to a wrapping field. `className` and `style` land on the root wrapper (the visible box); every other prop, `ref` included, lands on the native `<input>`.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Sets `aria-invalid="true"` on the `<input>` and the danger border on the root.

props.name: startAdornment
props.description: Decorative unless you give it meaning: mark icons `aria-hidden`.

props.name: ref
props.description: Reaches the native `<input>`.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Native checkbox drawn by CSS, wrapped in a `<label>` so the whole row is the click target. `className` and `style` land on the root `<label>`; every other prop, `ref` included, lands on the native `<input type="checkbox">`.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Sets `aria-invalid="true"` on the `<input>` and the danger border on the box.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Shows the mixed state through the DOM `indeterminate` property; never changes `checked`.

props.name: children
props.description: The visible label. Without it, pass `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`.

props.name: ref
props.description: Reaches the native `<input>`.

components.name: Switch
components.description: Native `<input type="checkbox" role="switch">` drawn by CSS as a track and thumb, wrapped in a `<label>`. `className` and `style` land on the root `<label>`; every other prop, `ref` included, lands on the native input. `readOnly` has no effect on a checkbox-type input: use `disabled`.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Sets `aria-invalid="true"` on the `<input>` and the danger border on the track.

props.name: children
props.description: The visible label, after the track. Without it, pass `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`.

props.name: ref
props.description: Reaches the native `<input>`.

components.name: Spinner
components.description: Indeterminate loading indicator. `role="status"` exposes a polite live region named by a visually hidden `t('spinner.loading')`; a caller's `aria-label` overrides that name and `aria-hidden` makes it decorative. Consumes semantic tokens only; the ring uses `currentColor`.

components.name: Icon
components.description: Semantic glyph rendering the active skin's SVG via `currentColor`. Decorative by default (`aria-hidden`); an `aria-label`/`aria-labelledby` makes it a labelled `role="img"`. Both skins' SVGs ship and CSS shows the one matching the `[data-skin]` ancestor (ADR 0020).

components.name: Divider
components.description: Rule separating content. Horizontal (default) renders a native `<hr>`; vertical renders a `<div role="separator" aria-orientation="vertical">`, since a native `<hr>` is semantically horizontal-only. Either way it is a semantic separator by default; a caller wanting it purely decorative passes `role="none"` or `aria-hidden` (which also drops `aria-orientation`). Consumes semantic tokens only; the parent layout owns the surrounding spacing, and vertical needs a sized container to fill.

components.name: Indicator
components.description: Inline status dot. The root is a `<span role="img">` named by the required `aria-label` (the state, e.g. "Available"), so the state is never colour-only (WCAG 1.4.1); `intent` only tints the dot. A caller whose visible text already states the state passes `aria-hidden` to make it decorative. `pulse` adds a live halo that stops under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

components.name: Avatar
components.description: Circular identity picture: the `src` image, else `initials`, else a neutral user icon. `alt` names it in every state; `alt=""` hides it from assistive technology as decorative.

components.name: Container
components.description: Generic page-width wrapper: caps its content at a `variantSize` max-width, centers it and adds horizontal gutters that widen on larger viewports. Layout only — no colour, no vertical spacing. `variantSize="full"` removes the cap. Renders a `<div>`; pass element semantics (`role`, `aria-*`) through props.

components.name: Grid
components.description: Generic responsive grid: lays children in up to `columns` equal columns with a `gap`, reflowing to fewer columns (down to one) as its own width shrinks. Layout only — no colour, no spacing above or below. Renders a `<div>`; pass element semantics (`role`, `aria-*`) through props.

components.name: Stack
components.description: Generic one-direction stack: lays children in a `row` or `column` with a consistent `gap`, and optionally aligns them along each axis (`alignItems` cross-axis, `justify` main-axis). Layout only — no colour, no spacing above or below. Renders a `<div>`; pass element semantics through.

components.name: Heading
components.description: Section heading. `level` picks the real `<h1>`–`<h6>` for the document outline; `variantSize` sets the visual size independently, so semantic level and appearance are decoupled. Type is token-driven and reskins across the theme and skin axes (the display serif in neutral, the pixel font in the pixel skin).

props.name: level
props.description: The semantic document level, rendered as the matching `<h1>`–`<h6>`.

props.name: variantSize
props.description: The visual size, decoupled from `level`; defaults to the level's own step.

components.name: Text
components.description:
Body and inline text. `as` picks the element (`

` block or `` inline). `tone` maps to `--omnia-color-text-primary` or `--omnia-color-text-muted`; the muted tone still meets WCAG contrast. Type is token-driven and reskins across the theme and skin axes, staying sans in both skins.

components.name: LanguageSwitcher
components.description: Segmented toggle for the FR/EN locale axis. Reads `locale` and calls `setLocale` on the nearest `OmniaThemeProvider`, so it takes no value props — the provider is the single source of truth. One button per locale, each labelled with its own endonym and `lang`; the active one carries `aria-pressed`. The group root gets a localized accessible name; `className`, `style` and `ref` land on it, and any other native attribute spreads onto it.

props.name: ref
props.description: Reaches the group root.

components.name: ThemeSwitcher
components.description: Segmented toggle for the light/dark theme axis (not the skin). Reads `theme` and calls `setTheme` on the nearest `OmniaThemeProvider`, so it takes no value props — the provider is the single source of truth. One icon-only button per theme, each with a localized accessible name; the active one carries `aria-pressed`. The group root gets a localized accessible name; `className`, `style` and `ref` land on it, and any other native attribute spreads onto it.

props.name: ref
props.description: Reaches the group root.

components.name: Card
components.description: Surface grouping related content, with optional `Card.Header`, `Card.Body` and `Card.Footer` parts composed in source order. Every part is a plain `<div>` with no role of its own: wrap the card in an `<article>` or a list item when its content stands alone. Consumes semantic tokens only, reskins across the theme and skin axes, and steps its padding up with its own width; footer actions wrap on a narrow card.

components.name: DescriptionList
components.description: Term–detail pairs on a native `<dl>`. Each `DescriptionList.Item` is a `<div>` group holding one `DescriptionList.Term` (`<dt>`) and its `DescriptionList.Detail` (`<dd>`). Terms and details stack when the list is narrow and sit side by side once it is wide enough (a container query on the list's own width). Consumes semantic tokens only; themes/skins reskin it.

components.name: FormField
components.description: Field wrapper that links a label, a description and an error to one control. The control is rendered through `FormField.Control render` or wired with `useFormField()`: atoms never read the field. Display only by default; with `validateOn` it also shows the control's native constraint validation with an Omnia message, unless the form has `noValidate`.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Shows `FormField.Error` and marks the control `aria-invalid`; `true` wins over native validity.

props.name: required
props.description: Adds the `*` indicator to the label and native `required` to the control.

props.name: validateOn
props.description: Shows the control's native constraint validation: on a submit attempt, plus on blur, on every change, or on first blur then every change. Omitted, the field only displays `invalid`.

props.name: validationMessages
props.description: Replaces the Omnia message for a failing native validity key.

props.name: render
props.description: Renders the control: spread `props` on it and pass `state.invalid` to an Omnia atom.

components.name: List
components.description: Semantic list of short related items. `as` picks `<ul>` (bullets) or `<ol>` (numbers); compose it with `List.Item` children, which may nest another List. Token-driven, so it reskins across the theme and skin axes.

components.name: NavBar
components.description: Navigation bar: a labelled `<nav>` holding a list of `NavBar.Link` parts, each a standalone `Link`. Links wrap onto new lines on narrow screens; the current page's link is marked.

props.name: children
props.description: `NavBar.Link` parts; each renders as an item of the bar's list.

props.name: current
props.description: Marks the link to the page being shown (`aria-current="page"`); a caller `aria-current` wins.

components.name: SectionHeading
components.description: Title row of a page section or panel. `Title` renders a `Heading` (its `level` stays yours), `Description` a muted `Text`, and `Actions` sits opposite the title once the component itself is wide enough, dropping under the text when narrow.

components.name: Stat
components.description: Headline figures on a native `<dl>` of one or more `Stat.Item` figures. In each item the `Stat.Label` (`<dt>`) is written first and the `Stat.Value` (`<dd>`) is drawn above it. `orientation` lays items in a wrapping row or one column. Consumes semantic tokens only.

props.name: orientation
props.description: `horizontal` lays items in a row that wraps; `vertical` keeps them in one column.

components.name: AppHeader
components.description: Global app header: `AppHeader.Brand` at the start, `AppHeader.Nav` (holding a `NavBar`) and `AppHeader.Actions` (switchers, buttons) at the end. Below `48em` the brand stays and a "Menu" disclosure button shows or hides a panel holding every other part; Escape, a link, an outside click or focus leaving the header closes it. `AppHeader.Brand` must be a direct child to stay outside that panel. Every part is a plain `<div>`: mount it inside `PageTemplate.Header`, which renders the one `<header>` banner landmark.

components.name: PageHeader
components.description: Title block at the top of a page's content, placed once inside `PageTemplate.Main`. Renders no landmark. `PageHeader.Breadcrumb` (a direct child, any node) sits above a `SectionHeading` that holds `PageHeader.Title` (an `<h1>` by default), `PageHeader.Description` and `PageHeader.Actions`.

props.name: level
props.description: The document level of the title; a page title is an `<h1>` unless you say otherwise.

components.name: PageTemplate
components.description: Generic slot-based page scaffold: a CSS-grid frame whose regions — `PageTemplate.Header`, `PageTemplate.Navbar`, `PageTemplate.Main`, `PageTemplate.Aside`, `PageTemplate.Footer` — render the matching landmark element and are all opt-in except `Main`. Regions stack on a narrow viewport and lay `Navbar | Main | Aside` side by side from `48em`. Carries no content of its own; a skip link to `Main` is rendered first. Consumes semantic tokens only and reskins across the theme and skin axes.
